body: The kit's seal is broken at one corner only. A gloved hand pins down a clipboard turned to a numbered stop rather than a patient; the same number is stamped on a grower's supply chit behind it, its delivery marked returned, not received.
title: A stop number, twice stamped
gloss: A route sheet's numbered stop matches a grower's supply chit marked returned, not received.
rival_reading: A grower's chit and a returned delivery could belong to an ordinary supply round disrupted by nothing more than a missed pickup; a stop revised on a route sheet does not by itself show a response that failed.

body: The bandage wrapper is marked for a field patient. The bottle has no name, only a time and a green line. The transfer sheet says hold until cleared; a nurse has written, ‘Mother waiting,’ on the back.
title: Field supplies without a source
gloss: Field medical supplies carry a time and a personal note while their source remains absent.
rival_reading: A rushed response could hold a patient’s supplies while staff managed a movement restriction; the anonymous bottle does not establish a farm program malfunction.
